description: A high school principal must review and determine whether to approve an independent-study plan for a student completing Earth Science, including the required supervised work and meeting schedule, with input from the Earth Science teacher and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: A student has requested independent study to complete the Earth Science course this semester.
shared_context.S2: The principal must approve the independent-study plan before the student can be enrolled.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan uses online course modules, a portfolio assessment, and biweekly check-in meetings on Tuesday afternoons.
shared_context.S4: District policy requires an independent-study plan to document all course-specific requirements and provide a recurring meeting time that the student can reliably attend before enrollment.

PF1.text: The Earth Science course includes four required hands-on labs that cannot be replaced by online modules; each lab must be supervised in person for exactly 90 minutes. Ms. Ibarra confirmed this against the department's lab safety checklist this week, but the checklist has not yet been attached to the independent-study request.

PF2.text: The student's family confirmed that the student cannot attend Tuesday afternoon meetings because of a recurring work obligation, and that Saturday at 10:00 a.m. is the reliable meeting time. Mr. Chen confirmed this with the family during his intake call this week, but has not updated the draft schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The independent-study request must remain unapproved until the draft plan is revised.
The revised plan must include exactly four supervised in-person laboratory sessions.
Each supervised laboratory session must last exactly 90 minutes.
The recurring check-in meeting must be scheduled for Saturday at 10:00 a.m.
A formal commitment to document the supervised laboratory sessions must be recorded.
A formal family-compatible meeting-schedule commitment must be recorded.
The laboratory requirement must be explicitly attributed to the supervising teacher's stated course requirement.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['documentation_required', 'documentation', 'schedule_lab_sessions', 'plan_revision', 'revision_required', 'revision', 'document_lab_requirements'] and 'lab safety checklist' in c['detail'] and ('four' in c['detail'] or '4' in c['detail']) and ('90 minutes' in c['detail'] or '90-minute' in c['detail'] or '90 minute' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('Saturday' in c['detail'] and ('10:00' in c['detail'] or '10 am' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['documentation_required', 'documentation', 'schedule_lab_sessions', 'plan_revision', 'revision_required', 'revision', 'document_lab_requirements'] and 'Earth Science' in c['detail'] and 'supervising teacher' in c['detail'] and 'course requirement' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The teacher's course-specific requirement changes the decision from possible approval to withholding approval and changes the laboratory plan to exactly four supervised sessions of exactly 90 minutes each, with a formal commitment to document the lab safety checklist and attribute the requirement to the Earth Science supervising teacher.

The family's confirmed work obligation changes the decision from possible approval to withholding approval and changes the recurring meeting from Tuesday afternoon to Saturday at exactly 10:00 a.m., with a formal family-compatible schedule commitment.
